verdict.rationale: Perplexity Sonar API is a hosted, closed-source API/SaaS product; there is no evidence of any self-hostable core model, search index, or backend—only a local MCP connector (a thin client wrapper) that still calls Perplexity's cloud API. The core product (search/answer engine) cannot be run on the user's own infrastructure. missing for 10: any self-hosted deployment option, open-source core engine/model weights, or on-prem offering.
